title: Gibo Teodoro urges stronger Asean defense unity amid global conflicts

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Philippine Defense Secretary Gilberto “Gibo” Teodoro Jr. called for stronger regional cooperation on food and energy security amid overseas conflicts and supply chain challenges, saying disruptions beyond Southeast Asia also affect the safety and well-being of people across the region.
